name: demanage
description: Convenience scripts for the deManage monorepo. Each package keeps its own pnpm lockfile.

scripts.bootstrap: pnpm --dir backend install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir frontend install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir backend typecheck && pnpm --dir frontend typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir backend lint && pnpm --dir frontend lint
scripts.test: pnpm --dir backend test:unit && pnpm --dir frontend test
scripts.build: pnpm --dir backend build && pnpm --dir frontend build
